'''T-12 service droids''' were [[Service droid/Legends|service]] and [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in use during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].

==History==
T-12 service droids were employed by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to assist in cataloging [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] that were to be shipped to the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] after the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]]. They were also used at the [[Conclave at Deneba|Conclave on Deneba]] in [[3997 BBY]] when the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] unleashed their programming trap turning the simple serving droids into deadly [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]].

When [[Nomi Sunrider]] was captured attempting to rescue [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] from [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]] after he infiltrated the Krath, Qel-Droma reprogrammed a T-12 droid to take a message to Nomi, advising her to use her Jedi ability to escape and not come back for him. [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]] intercepted the droid before it could reach Nomi in the dungeons and after forcing the droid to reveal Qel-Droma's message, Satal ordered one of his [[Tetan shock trooper|shocktroopers]] to assassinate Qel-Droma.
